# Run registry (generated by scripts/build_registry.py; edit results/labels.tsv, not this file)

Test MAE, lower is better. ft = finetune, frz = frozen (lineareval), scr = scratchLOW. One seed unless noted.
`n=2` = the label has 2 collected jobs for that task; the newest is shown. Status void/smoke/old rows are
kept for the record, not for comparison.

Data versions: paired v1 = simu_paired_pretrain.tar (11-20; RIR tails not reproducible, no RIRs kept); paired v2 = simu_paired_pretrain_v2.tar (11-23; same scenes / utterances, per-scene gpuRIR seed, RIRs saved); unpaired-4s v1 = simu_pretrain.tar (Pilot A); unpaired-8s v2 = simu_unpaired8_pretrain.tar (V3).

## Decisions

<!-- Hand-edited; copied into RUNS.md by scripts/build_registry.py. Newest first. -->
- **2026-11-27, final 30-ep run LAUNCHED with ANCHORS=off (Yotam overrode the pre-registered rule).** The pre-registered rule (11-26) chose ON because noanc's linear SID was 1.0 point lower (45.1 vs 46.1). Yotam overrode it: the rule's SID clause lacked the project's 1.5-pt noise threshold for speech probes, and with that threshold OFF passes. V1b-A′-noanc vs V1b A′ λ0.1 (10 ep, paired v2, one seed each), off vs on: SID −1.0 linear / +2.0 ridge (45.1 / 44.8 vs 46.1 / 42.8); TDOA −12% (linear 1.31 vs 1.49, ridge 1.30 vs 1.43); SC2 +2.4 linear / +2.8 ridge (24.7 / 25.5 vs 22.3 / 22.7); T60 a tie on the linear probe (0.088 vs 0.090), 7% worse on ridge (0.046 vs 0.043); DRR ridge 1.31 vs 1.29, linear pending (rerun 23803481; the first spatial eval timed out). OFF is also the simpler method (swap + SAC only). Runs pilotc_v1bA30noanc_l01_s1 / _s2 (labels jointcv1bA30noancl01s{1,2}_*, scripts/launch_v1bA30.sh; only nepoch / seed / own_scale differ from pilotc_v1bA_l01's args.json), compared with C 30 ep (pilotC30_v2r). **Watch T60 / DRR in the 30-ep seeds** (dropping anchors from C cost 10% on T60, 11-24). The anchors-on 10-ep run (pilotc_v1bA_l01) stays as the ablation row. **Standing rule: future decision rules use the 1.5-pt noise threshold for speech probes.**
- **2026-11-26, the final run is V1b A′ λ0.1 at 30 epochs, 2 seeds (prepared, not launched); the anchors setting depends on V1b-A′-noanc.** scripts/launch_v1bA30.sh (ANCHORS=on|off): pilotc_v1bA_l01's config with --nepoch 30, seeds 1 and 2, paired v2, new recipe. Checked against its args.json: only nepoch, seed and (ANCHORS=off) own_scale differ, plus snapshot retention. Runs pilotc_v1bA30_l01_s{1,2} (labels jointcv1bA30l01s{1,2}_*) or pilotc_v1bA30noanc_l01_s{1,2} (jointcv1bA30noancl01s{1,2}_*). Gate, full eval set and check 4a as for the 10-ep runs. **The baseline row is C 30 ep** (standing rule 11-25), and its ridge dump goes into each run's ridge probe. **Anchors rule:** turn them off if V1b-A′-noanc is no more than ~5% worse than V1b A′ λ0.1 on each of TDOA, T60 and DRR, and no worse on SC2 and SID. Otherwise keep them on. If noanc's evals are not in by Fri 27 Nov 09:00, launch with anchors on. V2 (CKA) moves after the sprint unless GPUs are free after this launch; its smoke test is rerun (L40S / A6000 only) only then.
- **2026-11-26, at matched λ the learned room teacher keeps reverberation information much better than hand-crafted cues; TDOA is about equal.** V1b-HC λ1 (the C + SAC spatial cues as the spatial teacher, same spectral teacher, σ from the same ESS rule, τ 0.7) vs V1b A′ λ1, both 10 ep, paired v2, one seed. Spatial encoder: TDOA 1.70 vs 1.79, but T60 0.125 vs 0.082 (C v2 0.067). DRR and the λ0.1 spatial evals were still pending when this was written. **The T60 cost follows how well each teacher's cues track reverb.** Spearman of cue distance vs the reverb factor (cue_check rho_reverb) is oracle B 0.64, A′ 0.23, HC 0.20. Spatial-encoder T60 at λ1 is B 0.065, A′ 0.082, HC 0.125. The ordering is monotonic but not proportional: A′ and HC are close in ρ (0.23 vs 0.20) yet far apart in T60, so ρ alone does not predict the size of the cost.
- **2026-11-25, V3 prepared (unpaired swap; Yotam submits): does the swap work without paired simulation?** Run pilotc_v3 (labels jointcv3_*, scripts/launch_v3.sh): C v2 10 ep's recipe and loss weights (anchors on, own-scale 0.1, seed 1), trained on the unpaired 8.224-s set with --v3 (target = first half as recorded; spectral input = the first half WPE-dereverberated, convolved with the RIR of another paired-v2 training room, random EQ; spatial input = the second half of the same clip). Checked against pilotC_v2r/args.json: only --v3, the tar and --val-scenes (2500 of 25,000) differ (+ snapshot retention). **Primary readout: all five tasks (TDOA / T60 / DRR / SC2 / SID) vs C v2 10 ep.** Spectral leakage is secondary. Check 4a is run on C v2's paired-v2 validation split (500 scenes). Caveat: V3 changes the data and the view construction together, so a difference from C v2 cannot be split between them.
- **2026-11-25, "Is A′'s early / late split engineered?" No, it is needed (A′-uniform ablation).** A′-uniform = A′ design 1's objective, decoders, cross-channel masking, budget and probes, with one generic input: ipd16 over the whole RIR (Hann 512 / hop 256, 56 frames x 256 bins, 224 tokens, frames past the true RIR length masked), no late-envelope tokens, one attention pool. Held-out ridge probes, A′-uniform vs A′ (vs random init): TDOA 1.16 vs 1.03 (2.52), DRR 2.21 vs 0.93 (2.48), C50 0.70 vs 0.30 (1.10), T60 0.0251 vs 0.0135 (reported only: A′'s envelope exposes the RIR length). Spearman of embedding distance vs oracle-B distance / |dTDOA| / reverb factor: 0.14 / 0.22 / 0.09 vs A′ 0.32 / 0.21 / 0.23. Without the late view DRR and C50 fall to near random init and the reverb structure is lost, while TDOA survives: the split carries the reverberation information. (code/rir_compare.py, exp/rir_encoder/a1u_uniform/compare.json.) Consequence: V1b-U-noanc (A′-uniform as the spatial teacher) is not launched; A′ stays the V1 room teacher.
- **2026-11-25, V1b-A′-noanc launched: are the MPG / MPC anchors needed under V1b?** Identical to V1b A′ λ0.1 (same spectral and spatial cues, σ / τ, recipe, 10 ep, paired v2, seed 1; checked against its args.json) except --own-scale 0. Run pilotc_v1bA_noanc_l01, labels jointcv1bAnoancl01_* (scripts/launch_v1bA_noanc.sh). Compare with V1b A′ λ0.1 and with swap-only (C without anchors, 11-24).
- **2026-11-25, 30-epoch comparisons use C 30 ep as the baseline row (standing rule).** Any run trained for 30 epochs is compared with C 30 ep (pilotC30_v2r, labels jointC30v2r_*), not with C 10 ep: training longer alone moves the speech probes (C 30 ep vs C 10 ep, linear SC2 / SID 23.8 / 45.9 vs 19.4 / 43.6; ridge spatial TDOA / T60 / DRR 1.95 / 0.043 / 1.22 vs 2.00 / 0.051 / 1.33).
- **2026-11-25, V1b's reduced spectral-encoder T60 leakage comes from the SPECTRAL dry-speech teacher, not the room teacher.** Spectral encoder on T60 (higher MAE = less leakage): V1b A′ λ0.1 0.118, V1b oracle B λ0.1 0.126, vs C v2 0.064 (random init 0.198). Both V1b runs share the same spectral SAC term (dry-speech content-teacher cues, σ 0.7565 / τ 0.6) and differ only in the room teacher, which acts on the spatial encoder; so the drop in reverb leakage is attributed to the spectral teacher.
- **2026-11-25, RIR-length leak in every RIR encoder (recorded; not fixed in current runs).** gpuRIR ends each RIR at the 40-dB decay time (Tmax = att2t_SabineEstimator(40, T60), data_generation/utils_simu_rir_sig.py), and the stored RIRs are zero-padded to the set's longest (13,868 samples, both data-v2 sets), so where the padding starts encodes the simulated T60. Every RIR encoder can read it: v1 / v2 / A′ through the zero-padding cliff, A′-uniform through its rir_len frame mask. Evidence: a ridge on log RIR length alone gives T60 MAE 0.031 s, and the T60 probe does not separate encoders (A′ random init 0.0137 vs trained 0.0135). Consequence: T60 probes of RIR encoders are uninformative; **the A′-uniform "late view matters" branch uses C50 (and DRR), not T60** (code/rir_compare.py). **Planned fix for any future teacher training (not applied to current runs):** pad every RIR to the full 13,868 samples with low-level noise (about -60 dB re peak) so length carries no information, and add a "T60 from the length alone" check to the probe report.
- **2026-11-25, V1a: the spectral side is the best so far, the spatial side regresses.** V1a λ1 (10 ep, paired v2, new recipe, one seed): spatial encoder on T60 0.164 vs C v2 0.067 (spatial-side regression; TDOA 1.75 vs 2.38, DRR pending a rerun lost to the 11-25 quota incident). Spectral encoder SC2 26.0 / SID 48.7 linear (ridge 31.4 / 53.1) vs C v2 19.4 / 43.6: the best SID of any joint run and the best SC2 + SID together (C2 has higher SC2, 26.6 / 28.4, but loses ~19 points of SID); spatial encoder on SC2 / SID 7.1 / 1.8 (least speech leakage after C2). **Hybrid candidate for later:** V1a's spectral loss (dry-speech latent prediction) + V1b's spatial loss (teacher-cue SAC). V1b needs a λ-matched control before its gain can be credited to the teacher rather than λ (old C + SAC ran at λ 0.02): **V1b-HC** (Yotam 11-25), the V1b trainer with V1b A′'s spectral SAC unchanged (dry-speech teacher cues, same σ / τ) and the hand-crafted C + SAC spatial cues (5 features, z-normed, scene mean of the 4 renderings) through the precomputed-cue option; spatial σ from the same ESS step, spatial τ = A′'s 0.7 (no τ sweep); λ 0.1 / 1, paired v2, new recipe, 10 ep (scripts/launch_v1bhc.sh). The only difference from V1b A′ is the spatial cue source.
- **2026-11-24, MPG/MPC anchors are not the source of the spectral encoder's reverberation leakage.** Swap-only (Pilot C with --own-scale 0, no MPG/MPC anchor losses) vs C, both 10 ep on paired v2 with the new recipe, one seed: spectral encoder on T60 0.066 vs 0.064 (DRR 1.79 vs 1.77; random init 0.198 / 2.63). Each encoder alone: TDOA 2.28 vs 2.38, T60 0.074 vs 0.067, DRR 1.46 vs 1.40, SC2 24.8 vs 19.4, SID 45.5 vs 43.6. A second swap-only seed is a post-sprint candidate.
- **2026-11-23, V1 room teacher: a LEARNED RIR encoder (A′) is the published teacher; the oracle parameter teacher B is an analysis row only.** A′ needs only RIRs (simulated or measured, no labels); B (z-scored simulator TDOA, T60, DRR, C50, room volume, source-mic distance) needs ground-truth room parameters, which real data almost never has, so B is reported as "oracle SAC", an upper bound on how good the teacher's soft weights can be. V1a's spatial side only ever uses a learned teacher (V1a with B would be supervised regression of the evaluation targets); V1a's spectral side (dry-speech teacher) is unchanged. Two masked-reconstruction RIR encoders (v1: whole-RIR STFT; v2: early STFT + late envelope, per-channel tokens) carry no TDOA (held-out 2.86 samples = mean predictor) because nothing in their objective needs the inter-channel relation and mean pooling dilutes the direct-path tokens; A′ fixes the objective (cross-channel), the input (the student's ipd16) and the pooling (attention over early tokens). Pass test (revised 23 Nov): TDOA MAE <= 1.95 samples (2x the best Step-0 hand-feature linear readout, 0.97; ridge on early ipd16 + GCC-PHAT; this is a linear-readout reference, not a ceiling for a learned encoder, which can compute the delay nonlinearly), T60 / DRR / C50 no worse than the same encoder at random init (0.015-0.016 / 1.12-1.22 / 0.41-0.47; v2 reported alongside), Spearman of embedding vs true-parameter distances reported. "Useful as a teacher" = TDOA <= ~1.3 (at or better than C2 seed 1's 1.24; students: C 2.23-2.38, C2 1.24 / 1.97). Pass + useful -> A' is the V1 room teacher; pass but not useful -> report and propose design 2 (GCC-PHAT tokens as an extra input stream; GCC-PHAT was the best single hand feature for TDOA); fail -> design 2. At most two designs; then stop and decide. **Thesis framing:** V1 with a learned RIR teacher is still learning with privileged information (it needs each training clip's RIR, simulated or measured, but no labels); the oracle B row bounds it from above; V3 (unpaired) is the from-the-wild version.
- **2026-11-23, sprint go/no-go: GO on the joint (two-encoder) design, with Pilot C as the base.** C beats A on all five frozen tasks, each encoder alone, on both seeds (TDOA 2.23 / 2.38 vs 2.57; T60 0.076 / 0.063 vs 0.084; DRR 1.55 / 1.41 vs 2.32; SC2 20.9 / 20.9 vs 14.8; SID 43.8 / 44.5 vs 34.0). Concat goes to an appendix (ridge concat is worse than the best single encoder on TDOA, SC2 and SID). Pre-agreed rule met: C2 seed 2 neither keeps C2's TDOA gain nor removes its T60 / SID losses. **C2 is kept as the contrastive variant:** best TDOA (1.24 / 1.97, the gain mostly from seed 1) and SC2 (26.6 / 28.4), leakage at random-init level both ways (spectral on T60 0.196 / 0.220 vs random 0.198; spatial on SID 0.6 / 1.0 vs 9.1), but it loses T60 (0.100 / 0.105) and ~19 points of SID (26.0 / 25.0, below the random-init spectral encoder's 36.6). Follow-ups: C 10 ep + swap-only ablation + C 30 ep reference on paired v2 with the new recipe; C2 + 2-layer head diagnostic (pilotC2_head, paired v1, lower priority). Table: exp/gonogo_table_2026-11-23.md (scripts/gonogo_table.py).
